'''''Ceradenia jungermannioides''''', the '''mossy finger fern''', is a species of fern in the family [[Polypodiaceae]] indigenous to the [[Neotropical realm]] (in the [[Caribbean]] and the [[Amazon rainforest]]) and the [[Azores]].
